title: Mixed Event — As the Leaves Change Once More — Episode3 Morning of the Trip

meta.Event: As the Leaves Change Once More
meta.Event Outline: After the success at Jam Fest, Shiho is energized to practice. But Shizuku and Saki invite her on a day trip to relax and enjoy the fall foliage.

rows.Line: The day of the trip - Early morning
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, I've finished my daily run, and I have everything packed for our trip!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What else do I have left to do...?
Oh, I still haven't done my morning strength exercises!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That was a close one! I'll need to do those to ensure that we have a wonderful day!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Starting with pushups!
Hmph! Hmph! Hnnnnnnng!!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Morning, Tsukasa.
You seem more excited than usual this morning.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Morning, Mom!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's because Saki and I are going on a trip for the first time in a very long while! I can't contain my excitement!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That reminds me. I made a special breakfast today as a way to boost my luck. Have some if you like, Mom.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, thank you.
I hope you two enjoy your trip.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We will!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, look at the time...
I need to wake Saki...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Inhale*

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Sakiiiiii!!!!!
It's moooorrrnnniiiinnnggg!!!!!!

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: Huh?! Tsukasa?!

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line:
You don't have to shout!
I'm already up!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Oh, you're checking to see if you've packed properly! Did you make sure to include bug repellent?

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It's in this bag...

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line:
No, it's not...!
Wait, where'd it go?!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. You two are so excited.
Shiho's Room

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Mhm... It's morning already...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Huh...? My alarm went off earlier than usual...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Oh, right... Today's...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Rin-Rin-Riiiin☆ It's morning!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Whoa...! You scared me...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Wakey wakey, Shih!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Relax... I'm already awake.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <What? But you're still snuggled up in your bed! You're gonna be late if you don't start getting ready soon!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, I'll get up. There's no need to rush.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hehe. I'm so excited about visiting that cafe, picking fruits and seeing some pretty leaves!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Thanks again for agreeing to let me go with you today, Shih♪>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, you looked like you really wanted to go the other day when I told you about this trip...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think Shizuku and Tsukasa won't notice as long as you don't pop out too often.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Right! I should be fine since I can just sneakily watch from your pocket or Sakki's☆>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Voice
rows.Line: Shii?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Voice
rows.Line:
Shii, are you awake?
We're going to be late if you don't get up soon.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm already up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Morning, Shii.
I'm glad we were both able to wake up early like we planned.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You didn't have to worry about that. I had an alarm set for today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, Shizuku, you've got bed head...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Look, around your right ear. This bit of hair's sticking up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
What? But I thought I got it all...
I-I'll go fix it now...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
She's so careless when it comes to these things.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <She might've been distracted because she's just that excited about today. That happens to me a lot!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, you also seem like the type to forget about fixing your bed head before going somewhere.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <What?! R-Really?!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But you've also gotten so excited about something that you forgot about other stuff, right?!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't think so...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <O-Or ended up just spinning your wheels...?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Nope.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Y-Yeah, I probably am barking up the wrong tree...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<But you are excited about this trip, right?
I mean, you kept checking the weather forecast yesterday.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Of course I kept checking the forecast.
Depending on the weather, we would've had to pack differently.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I am glad that it's supposed to be nice out today.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Yeah!
So let's have lots of fun on today's trip♪>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, within reason...
